text: Novera, Sept. 14 — Survey crews at the Hadrow Flats site identified a lithium brine deposit during drilling last week, according to people familiar with the matter. The find was confirmed in core samples taken from the southern basin, where saline fluid at depth showed elevated lithium concentrations across three test wells. Project geologist Mara Venn briefed investors on Monday and said the brine zone appears laterally continuous over several kilometers, with preliminary grades stronger than earlier field estimates. Early assays are being reviewed by the independent lab Quillgate Analytics, and a follow-up resource model is expected later this month. The discovery could accelerate plans for pilot extraction at the remote desert prospect.
